about: Rented graphics machines, and whether any job needs one yet. Read 2026-11-28.
why_not_yet: Every free model in the registry runs on an Apple-silicon Mac (pictures, transcripts, upscaling, voice, short video drafts). Final video clips are made by the generative model house per clip. A rented machine pays only when a job runs an open model too big for the Mac, many hours a day.
turn_on_when: a local model job queues longer than a night on the Mac, or a trained identity needs training

options.note: 71 credits an hour at 0.05 a credit
needs account tier 2 or more; only some regions (always-on/prices.json)
